name: copy_course_input_field
description: Copies one 32-bit word, reached through a pointer chain in the base-relative data area, into a fixed field of the same area. Called from the dialog opener and returns nothing.

name: open_file_stream
description: Claims a free stream record and reopens it for the requested file and mode. Returns zero to the caller when no stream record is free.

name: reopen_stream_with_mode
description: Closes the stream's current file, looks up the requested mode string in a fixed table, and opens the file with the matching flags. It records the descriptor and buffer state, and sets error code 6 with a zero result when no mode matches.

name: clear_data_and_start_program
description: Zeroes a long block of words in the data area, saves the stack pointer and a global value into that area, then calls the runtime initialiser. It is the program entry point, reached through a handler pointer stored in data.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and returns a negative, zero or positive value by unsigned comparison. The comparison stops at a fixed length limit.

name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares at most a given number of characters of two strings with the same negative, zero or positive ordering. It returns zero when the limit is reached without a difference.

name: create_file_for_writing
description: Opens a file with the flags that create or truncate it for writing. It passes the path and the remaining argument to the general open routine.

name: open_file_descriptor
description: Finds a free entry among twenty open-file slots and, when an exclusive flag is set, locks and deletes any existing file first. It then opens or creates the file, records the descriptor and mode, and returns -1 with an error code stored when the open fails.

name: compute_signed_quotient
description: Sets the sign of the result from the signs of the operands, calls the unsigned division routine, and negates its quotient when the signs require it.

name: compute_signed_remainder
description: Sets the sign from the operand signs, calls the unsigned division routine, and returns its remainder with that sign.

name: return_unsigned_remainder
description: Calls the unsigned division routine and returns only the remainder it leaves in the second result register.

name: perform_32_bit_division
description: Divides a 32-bit unsigned dividend by a 32-bit unsigned divisor and returns the quotient and remainder together. A native division is used when the divisor fits in 16 bits, otherwise a bit-by-bit shift-and-subtract loop runs.

name: write_bytes_to_stream
description: Writes a block of bytes one at a time through the single-character output routine. It returns the requested count when every byte is written and zero when a character write fails.

name: put_char_to_stream_buffer
description: Stores one character in the stream buffer and advances the buffer pointer when space remains. When the buffer is full, it passes the character to the flush routine.

name: close_all_open_streams
description: Walks the table of stream records in fixed-size steps up to a bound, closing each record. The flush routine stores its address in a global slot, so it is used as a callback.

name: close_stream
description: Closes a stream if it is open. It flushes pending output when the stream was written, closes the descriptor, frees an owned buffer, and deletes a temporary file when flagged, then clears the record and returns zero, or -1 for a null stream.

name: flush_stream_and_write_char
description: Writes a stream's pending buffered bytes to its file, then either stores the given character in the buffer or writes it directly. It sets the stream's error state and returns -1 when a write fails.

name: allocate_stream_record
description: Scans the stream table for an unused record, clears its pointer fields, and returns it. It returns zero when every record is in use.

name: allocate_stream_buffer
description: Gives a stream a 1024-byte buffer unless its file is a terminal or the allocation fails. In those cases it uses a one-byte internal buffer and records the buffer size.

name: free_linked_memory_blocks
description: Walks a singly linked list of memory blocks, releasing each one with its stored size plus its header, then clears the list head. The long-allocation routine references it as its cleanup.

name: free_memory_chain_from_argument
description: Frees each block of a linked chain that starts at the pointer passed in the address register, following the stored next pointers. It then clears the list head.

name: allocate_tracked_block
description: Allocates a block with a header and stores the requested size in it. It links the block into the head of the allocation list, registers the cleanup routine, and returns the address past the header, or zero on failure.

name: allocate_memory_block
description: Forwards its size argument to the tracked allocator without further processing.

name: release_tracked_block
description: Searches the allocation list for the block at the given address, unlinks it, and releases it with its stored size plus header. Returns zero when the block is found and -1 when it is not in the list.

name: check_stream_is_interactive
description: Looks up the file identifier for a stream slot and asks the operating system whether that file is an interactive device. Returns true when it is.

name: delete_file_by_name
description: Deletes the named file through the operating-system routine. When deletion fails it stores the I/O error code and returns -1, otherwise it returns zero.

name: write_to_open_stream
description: Checks that a stream index is in range, that the slot is open, and that it has write access, then writes through the operating system. It stores an error code and returns -1 for an invalid index, an unopened slot, a slot without write access, or a failed write.

name: check_for_user_break
description: Reads and clears the break signal bit. When a break is pending and an output flag is set, it writes a message and calls the exit routine.

name: verify_word_then_exit
description: Compares a 16-bit value with a value derived from another register and calls the stored error handler when they differ. It then passes the status value from the program's data structure to the exit routine.

name: initialise_and_run_program
description: Opens the operating-system libraries and reads the start message of the process, showing an alert if a library fails to open. A workbench start sets the current directory and opens the first argument as input, while a command-line start splits the command text into words and runs the program's main routine before exiting.

name: shutdown_program_and_exit
description: Closes the first ten file slots, runs the registered cleanup routine, closes the opened libraries, and frees the saved argument and word buffers before exiting. A workbench start instead replies to the start message.

name: append_null_terminated_string
description: Moves to the terminating zero of the first string and copies the second string, including its terminator, onto the end. Returns the pointer to the first string.

name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends characters from the second string to the end of the first, stopping at a zero terminator or after a given count, and terminates the result. Returns the pointer to the first string.

name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the source pointer to the destination, including the terminator, and returns the destination pointer.

name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated string forward to its terminator and returns the number of characters before it. It does not modify memory.

name: copy_string_with_padding
description: Copies up to a given count of characters from the source to the destination, stopping after a zero terminator. It then fills the rest of the count with zero bytes.

name: close_file_slot
description: Checks that a file-slot index is in range and that the slot is in use, then closes its operating-system file unless the slot is flagged as not owned and clears the slot. Returns -1 with an error code stored for an invalid index, otherwise zero.

name: exit_through_dos_library
description: Calls the operating-system library's exit entry through the library base stored in the data area, ending the program.

name: call_dos_open
description: Calls the operating-system library's open entry through the library base stored in the data area, using arguments the caller has already placed.

name: call_dos_read
description: Calls the operating-system library's read entry through the library base stored in the data area, using arguments the caller has already placed.

name: call_alert_routine
description: Calls the library entry that displays a system alert, reached through the library base stored in the data area. It takes no arguments of its own.

name: query_available_memory
description: Calls the library entry that reports available memory, reached through the library base stored in the data area. Its result is left for the caller.

name: disable_task_switching
description: Calls the library entry that disables task switching, reached through the library base stored in the data area. The matching re-enable is made by other routines.

name: block_transfer_bitmap
description: Calls the graphics library's bitmap block-transfer entry through the library base stored in the data area.

name: copy_clipped_bitmap_region
description: Calls the graphics library's clipped block-transfer entry through the library base stored in the data area.

name: read_pixel_value
description: Calls the graphics library's pixel-read entry through the library base stored in the data area.

name: fill_rectangle
description: Calls the graphics library's rectangle-fill entry through the library base stored in the data area.

name: draw_text_string
description: Calls the graphics library's text-drawing entry through the library base stored in the data area. The number and text writing routines all call it.

name: clear_mouse_pointer
description: Calls the library entry that clears the mouse pointer image, reached through a second library base stored in the data area. The dialog loader calls it.

name: close_display_screen
description: Calls the library entry that closes a display screen, reached through the second library base stored in the data area. It takes no arguments of its own.

name: close_display_window
description: Calls the library entry that closes a display window, reached through the second library base stored in the data area. It takes no arguments of its own.

name: rebuild_display_screen
description: Calls the library entry that rebuilds a screen, reached through the second library base stored in the data area. The leaderboard display routine calls it.

name: open_display_screen
description: Calls the library entry that opens a display screen, reached through the second library base stored in the data area.

name: open_workbench_screen
description: Calls the library entry that opens the Workbench screen, reached through the second library base stored in the data area.

name: set_mouse_pointer
description: Calls the library entry that sets the mouse pointer image, reached through the second library base stored in the data area.
